# The Juris Associates

> The Juris Associates is a legal consultancy based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, led by Adv. Roshan Kumar (Founder & Principal Advocate). The firm handles cyber crime and digital fraud matters, bank account freeze, defreeze and lien removal, criminal defence and bail, civil and property disputes, corporate and commercial law, banking and finance, dispute resolution and arbitration, employment and labour law, and wills, succession and trusts. It represents clients across India.

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9211957859
- Email: infothejurisassociates@gmail.com
- Location: Kolkata, West Bengal, India (Pan-India practice)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM; Sunday by appointment
- Website: https://www.thejurisassociates.com

## Core practice

- [Bank Account Freeze, Defreeze & Lien Removal](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/bank-account-defreeze): accounts frozen or liens marked by banks at the request of cyber crime police (NCRP / 1930 complaints), including crypto P2P and UPI cases, anywhere in India.
- [Cyber Crime & Digital Law](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/cyber-crime): online investment and trading app fraud, crypto and P2P disputes, identity theft, cyber harassment, sextortion and online defamation, and defence against wrongful cyber allegations.

## Other practice areas

- [Criminal Law](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/criminal-law): bail and anticipatory bail, FIR matters, trials and appeals under the BNS, BNSS and BSA.
- [Civil Law & Corporate](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/civil-law-corporate): property disputes, recovery suits, injunctions, contract drafting.
- [Corporate & Commercial](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/corporate-commercial): company/LLP registration, M&A, fundraising, commercial contracts, compliance.
- [Banking & Finance](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/banking-finance): debt restructuring, recovery and enforcement, securitisation, loan documentation.
- [Dispute Resolution](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/dispute-resolution): commercial litigation, arbitration, NCLT and tribunal matters.
- [Employment & Labour Law](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/employment-labour): employment contracts, HR policies, ESOPs, labour code compliance.
- [Family Estates & Trust Planning](https://www.thejurisassociates.com/practice-areas/family-estates): wills, succession, private trusts, probate.
